jobs.title: Software Developer Engineer II
jobs.description: I joined Oracle Cloud Infrastructure as full-stack developer moving towards becoming a Front-end Engineer.
bullets: I helped and co-lead the initial expansion of OCI’s Marketplace service, being the owner of multiple React components.
Lead the initial bootstrap of OCI’s Service Catalog UI forking out of Marketplace, and in record time to comply with Gartner’s Cloud score for Gov compliance.

Lead the Sign-up experience to OCI Free-tier and Accounts Activation Portal across multiple enviorenments and private clouds, including owning my team’s UI code testing. Also helped bootstrap another services’s UI for Governance and working in the newly unified UI/UX team.

jobs.title: Software Developer Engineer
jobs.description: Our mission is to keep track and bringing to completion the payments and tax retentions for all of AWS Marketplace.
bullets: Accomplished full tax reporting automation by developing a new service using Spring and Hibernate and uploaded the encrypted file monthly to our stakeholders S3.
Delivered new micro-services on AWS Lambda and Step Functions to process all invoices for AWS Marketplace to reduce operational costs.
Developed and operated services using CI/CD pipelines with CloudWatch metrics, unit tests, integration test and acceptance tests.
Developed new APIs to integrate Marketplace Services to enhance how customer procure SaaS in the Marketplace.
